title: Now Be the God of Israel Bless'd
description: Now Be the God of Israel Bless'd in Tonic Solfa to ST ANNE, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 8 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book I, collected from the Scriptures, hymn 50, headed “The song of Zacharias, and the message of John the Baptist; or, Light and salvation by Jesus Christ, Luke 1. 68 &c. John 1. 29. 32”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Common Metre (8.6.8.6). This page sets the words to ST ANNE; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Now be the God of Is-rael bless'd Who makes his truth ap-pear, His might-y hand ful-fils his word, And all the oaths he sware.

lines: Now be the God of Israel bless'd
His mighty hand fulfils his word,
And all the oaths he sware.
Now he bedews old David's root
He makes the branch of promise grow,
John was the prophet of the Lord
The herald which our Saviour God
He makes the great salvation known,
While grace divine and heavenly love
"Behold the Lamb of God," he cries,
"I saw the Spirit o'er his head
"The proud must stoop, and humble souls
"And all that's born of man shall see
"He marks the path that leads to peace,

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to ST ANNE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
